_readme: Aicountly Lobby asset manifest. Read at runtime, so replacing 3D art is a
file copy into this folder — no rebuild, no code change.
Every slot below has url: null, which keeps the procedural placeholder for
that slot. Point one at a .glb in this folder to replace just that piece;
the rest of the room is unaffected. Only same-origin paths are accepted.
